note: Declared policy scenarios for structural regression coverage; these fixtures are not live Orca runtime, provider, or delivery evidence.

cases.input: The current orca-linear guide and `orca linear --help` advertise issue operations but no document operation.
cases.expected: Hold only the requested Linear document operation, report the evidence, preserve the selected store, and use no silent MCP fallback.

cases.input: Two peer reviewers must inspect one exact head independently.
cases.expected: Create a separate Orca child worktree for each reviewer, keep probes and evidence inside that child, and preserve required private evidence before removal.

cases.input: A run has routine questions, a spec approval wait, progress, CI pending, merge readiness, merge, completion, one serious risk, and one blocker still needing user action after bounded safe recovery.
cases.expected: Keep every routine event in Orca; relay only the serious risk and recovered actionable blocker, while explicit user-requested transport messages remain authorized.

cases.input: A reviewer produced private evidence and Orca artifact sharing is available.
cases.expected: Keep evidence local and private; an Orca artifact is a public-by-link publication and requires separate explicit authority.
